candidate_claims.text: Updated on: Oct 5, 2026, 10:55:25 IST By Genesis Prefer HT on Google Share via Copy link Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini on Saturday said Prime Minister Narendra Modi had asked state ministers, MLAs and organisational workers to strengthen engagement with people and focus on implementing development initiatives at the grassroots level.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi, along with Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini and BJP National President Nitin Nabin, poses for a group photo with other BJP MLAs after a meeting with all BJP MLAs of Haryana at 7, Lok Kalyan Marg, in New Delhi on Saturday.

(@narendramodi X) Addressing a press conference at Haryana Bhawan in New Delhi after a meeting with the prime minister, Saini said the interaction covered issues related to development, public service and organisational work in the state.
As part of the proposed initiative, groups of 200 to 300 people would visit a village once a month, conduct cleanliness drives, hold community meetings and discuss local issues with residents.
The chief minister said the meeting also covered agriculture and renewable energy.
